Bottom line: Your immediate focus should be on managing the significant drawdowns and breached stops in your leveraged tech/chip positions.
plays: Review breached stops on SOXL, MUU, SMCI, SMH, and QQQ. These leveraged positions are deep in the red and well below their stated stops, amplifying margin risk.
